title: Entrust — Role Insights Explorer and Access Review Playbook (prototype)
creator: Lina Chen
description: Design a compact, searchable Role Insights Explorer and a guided Access Review playbook for workspace and cross-workspace admins. The goal is to make role membership, permission drift, and reviewer actions discoverable and actionable inside the Redwood Console without overwhelming SREs and security reviewers. Deliverables: high-fidelity Figma screens, clickable prototype for stakeholder review, annotated flows for engineering, and an acceptance-ready handoff spec.
acceptance_criteria: Explorer shows aggregated role membership across selected workspaces with filters (role, permission, last-active)
Audit entries are grouped by actor and by permission change with a compact summary + expand for full event payload
Access Review playbook provides an end-to-end reviewer flow: schedule review, auto-suggest reviewers, approve/revoke in-line, and generate CSV export
Design handoff includes component tokens, responsive specs for 3 breakpoints, and edge-case states (no roles, many roles, pending reviews)
PM and Eng signoff after prototype usability session (5 participants) and one implementation feasibility sync
decisions: Show compact audit rows by default (actor + brief change summary) with a single chevron to expand full JSON payload — balances scannability and forensic needs
Expose a 'scope' selector (workspace / org / custom-set) so reviewers can narrow views without changing backend contracts
Add a permission-similarity cluster: group roles with overlapping permission sets to reduce review surface area
Defer inline sanction suggestions (AI-based) to a later phase; initial release surfaces historical reviewer actions as suggestions instead
tradeoffs: Compact rows improve scanning but hide full context; mitigated by prominent expand and search within expanded payload
Clustering reduces noise but may hide edge-case roles; teams can opt-out per review
Export-first approach for compliance (CSV/PDF) increases backend load for large tenants — rate limits and async exports required
reviews: 2025-02-18 — PM review (Diego Rivera): requested clearer signals for SSO-derived vs user-assigned roles
2025-02-22 — Eng feasibility (Rohan Patel): recommended paginated audit API + cursor-based fetch; flagged large export performance
2025-02-27 — Security (Maya Singhal): asked for KMS audit stamp and retention policy note in UI copy
2025-03-03 — Design critique (Design org): reduced visual weight on role badges; accessibility pass requested for color contrast
usability_findings: Prototype sessions (5 enterprise admin participants): users preferred a filtered timeline over raw chronological logs
Reviewers wanted a quick 'revoke access' hot action directly on membership rows — added to next steps
Confusion between 'workspace-level roles' and 'cross-workspace grants' resolved by introducing inline badges and hover affordances
next_steps: Address Eng feedback: replace synchronous export with async job + email link; add rate-limit guidance to PRD
Implement accessibility fixes and update annotations for tokenized color system
Add microcopy explaining retention and KMS audit link per Security review
Schedule implementation kickoff with Frontend (Asha) and Backend (Rohan) on 2025-03-07
Prepare a short demo for Customer Success showing 'Access Review playbook' flow by 2025-03-12
notes: Link to cost tie-in: add small chart showing recent cost anomalies matched to role/activity spikes (optional MVP) — discussed with Product for phase 2
Consider adding a 'can act as' column for service-accounts and delegated roles in a follow-up
Localization: ensure date/time formats honor workspace locale settings
